h: Faith and Teshuvah Restore the Holiness of Knesses Yisrael

p: In the holy Zohar on this parshah (III 42b):
אֵשֶׁת חַיִל מִי יִמְצָא (מִשְׁלֵי לא, י)
"'A woman of valor, who can find?' (Mishlei 31:10)
which is a woman of valor,
That is, as is written above:
"A woman of valor — this is Knesses Yisrael,
over many hosts and many camps, etc."
And it is as they said in the Gemara (end of Berachos):
תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים אֵין לָהֶם מְנוּחָה כוּ׳
and from beis midrash to beis midrash."
"'Come, my beloved, let us go out to the field'
come and I will show you talmidei chachamim
who toil in Torah amid hardship, etc.;
'let us rise early to the vineyards'
these are the batei knesses and batei midrash;
'let us see whether the vine has blossomed'
these are the masters of Scripture;
these are the masters of Mishnah;
these are the masters of Gemara;
'there I will give you my love'
I will show you the praise of My greatness," etc.
And this is that she is mistress
over many hosts and many camps:
the camps of the masters of Scripture,
the masters of Mishnah and the masters of Talmud;
in the batei knesses and the batei midrash.
And in another version it is stated there
"For through the union with the King
she brought forth many hosts, etc."
that is, the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu
is through those who toil in Torah.
those who engage in Torah she'b'al peh:
we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
And it says in the holy Zohar:
who will merit to be in it in completeness,
and to be found with it constantly,
'Who shall ascend the mountain of Hashem, etc.'"
and "to be found with it constantly."
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
based on what is written in the holy Zohar
who is the end of days, etc."
which is also called the holy Mother,
as they said in the Midrash
"He did not cease showing them affection
'Listen to Me, My people, and My nation (le'umi),' etc."
And one must interpret "the holy Mother"
"And for your transgressions your mother was sent away";
and she is the end of days.
are called the seven days of Creation,
כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה ה׳ וְגוֹ׳
and it is not written "in six."
And the Torah preceded by two thousand years
as is inferred (in Midrash Rabbah on Metzora, Vayikra Rabbah 19:1)
"And I was with Him as a nursling,
and the day of HaKadosh Baruch Hu
And that is chochmah and binah.
in the utterance "Let there be light,"
corresponding to the five books of the Torah
"and He said" is not stated in it,
for it is the intellect hidden from all thought;
and the first day is chochmah,
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar on this parshah
(III 43, end of amud b, in the Ra'aya Mehemna):
this is the holy sign of the covenant,
and it is the eighth of all the levels":
the trait of "the tzaddik, foundation of the world,"
is the eighth day counting from chochmah,
which is called the first day;
and the trait of Malchus, Knesses Yisrael,
וְאָמַר אַחַר כָּךְ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (תִּשָּׂא שָׁם)
And afterward it says in the holy Zohar (Ki Sisa there):
"'And it shall be in the end of days (Yeshayahu 2:2)
that the mountain of the House of Hashem shall be established
at the head of the mountains.'
Who is 'the head of the mountains'?
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ
And it is based on what they said in the Midrash
and Avraham Avinu, first of the other mountains,
is called the head of the mountains;
and "the mountain of the House of Hashem"
And Avraham is called the great kohen:
kohen is the trait of chessed;
and he is called the great kohen
because he merited the trait of elder,
"And Avraham was old, advanced in days,"
(חַיֵּי, חֵלֶק א קכט סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(Chayei Sarah, I 129, end of amud a):
that there is an intellect hidden from all thought,
and he was refined in his trait up to Atika;
עַד אַבְרָהָם לֹא הָיָה זִקְנָה כוּ׳
"Until Avraham there was no old age," etc.
And it is stated in the Gemara (Pesachim 88a):
לֹא כְּאַבְרָהָם שֶׁכָּתוּב בּוֹ הַר כוּ׳
"Not like Avraham, of whom 'mountain' is written, etc.,
but like Yaakov, who called it a house";
and it is a house fixed forever,
"The lip of truth shall be established forever."
And this is why it says "the mountain of the House of Hashem":
And this is what is said:
"Who shall ascend the mountain of Havayah?"
yud is chochmah, hei is binah,
vav is tiferes, comprising six sefiros,
(as is written in the holy Zohar
חֵלֶק ג רנח סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ שָׁם י, ב)
(as is written in the holy Zohar there, 10b).
"Who shall ascend the mountain of Hashem"
And this is what it says:
"who will merit to be in it in completeness,"
for it is stated in the holy Zohar
and on the Field of holy Apples";
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (פְּסָחִים נו, א)
along the lines of what they said (Pesachim 56a):
"Just as there is in your heart only One,
so there is in our heart only One."
along the lines of what they said
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
"He is truth and He is faith"
"And who shall stand in His holy place?"
The Beis HaMikdash is called His holy place,
for it is called His footstool,
"And He did not remember His footstool."
(end of Makkos, 24a, and end of Eichah Rabbah)
הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם
HaKadosh Baruch Hu is the place of the world
from there Torah goes forth to all Yisrael
and in the Heichal is the Menorah,
which is the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
(and this has been explained many times).
And this is what it says:
"And who shall stand in His holy place?"
like Yaakov, who called it a house.
And this is what it says, "who will merit, etc.,
and to be found with it constantly," etc.

p: of what the holy Zohar brings,
'that which will befall you in the end of days'"
which has no connection at all
"who will merit to be in it in completeness."
Now in the gloss it is written
that this pasuk is not found,
and the intent is to what is said (Devarim 4:30):
"And all these things will befall you
it is stated in the holy Zohar
"'In the end of days' precisely, etc.;
and together with the end of days
and through it HaKadosh Baruch Hu will execute
'what this people will do to your people
that it executes vengeance upon the nations of the world.
to restore it to its place;
'And it shall be in the end of days
that it shall be established,' etc."
And it is based on what is written
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (יִתְרוֹ, חֵלֶק ב צא, א)
נ׳ רָזָא לְמִדְחַל מִקּוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
"Nun is the secret of fearing HaKadosh Baruch Hu
and knowing that there is judgment
and there is good reward for the righteous
And this is based on what is written
And this is what is written, "to fear, etc.,
and to know that there is judgment, etc.";
as is written: "Tzedek is the holy Malchus;
Tzedek is known to be judgment, etc.";
"the law of the kingdom is law"
"and into her hand He deposited all His weapons,"
as is written in the holy Zohar
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ שָׁם וּבְזֹהַר חֵלֶק ב נא, א)
(on this parshah there, and in Zohar II 51a).
And this is what it says:
for Knesses Yisrael is in exile;
"and He will execute vengeance for Yisrael"
upon the nations of the world
וְאַחַר כָּךְ זָמִין לְאָתָבָא לָהּ לְאַתְרָאָה
"and afterward He is destined to restore her to her place"
that is, good reward for the righteous;
everything is through the lower hei.
"And all these things will befall you
in the end of days," etc.:
all that they bore in exile,"
"And for your transgressions your mother was sent away"
all as the holy Zohar explains
He will perform miracles and vengeance, etc."
that is, good reward for the righteous
for Yisrael will be a chariot for the trait of Malchus
will be judgment for the nations of the world,
"what this people will do to your people
And this is why the holy Zohar here brings
as an introduction to what it says after this:
"'And her value is far above pearls,' etc.:
כָּל אִינּוּן דְּלָא אִתְדַּבְּקִין בָּהּ בִּשְׁלִימוּ כוּ׳
all those who do not cleave to her in completeness, etc.,
and then they are all far
from these supernal holy pearls, etc."
Pearls are the stones of the Efod,
יֵשׁ זָהָב וְרָב פְּנִינִים וְגוֹ׳ (מִשְׁלֵי כ, טו)
"'There is gold and an abundance of pearls, etc.' (Mishlei 20:15)
this is the offering of the Nesi'im, etc."
And the tribes are the root of Knesses Yisrael,
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי אֱמוּנָה מַשִּׂיגִין ה׳ אֶחָד
for through faith one grasps "Hashem is One,"
correspond to the twelve months and the twelve constellations
and the twelve hours of the day
and the twelve stones of the Efod
"It is a tradition that no tribe will be wiped out."
And these are the supernal holy pearls.
And this is only in the Beis HaMikdash,
וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמוֹתָם לִפְנֵי ה׳
"And Aharon shall bear their names before Hashem
on his shoulders as a remembrance."
לְכָל אִינּוּן דְּלָא אִתְדַּבְּקִין בָּהּ בִּשְׁלִימוּ כוּ׳
"all those who do not cleave to her in completeness, etc.,
they are far from these supernal holy pearls."
For the completeness of Knesses Yisrael
through which one grasps the entire unity,
And the pearls are borne only by the Kohen Gadol,
reaches up to the root, Kesser Elyon,
who merited the trait of elder,
as is written in the holy Zohar (Ki Sisa).
And in the Gemara too they expounded:
for the Kohen Gadol enters the Holy of Holies;
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קכא, א)
and it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 121a):
"'And wisdom, from where shall it be found?' (Iyov 28:12)
that is called the Holy of Holies."
And with the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash
they are far from these pearls, etc.
of the praise of Knesses Yisrael,
and for this it brings the introduction,
'and they will befall you, etc., in the end of days.'"
And there the conclusion of the verse is:
"And you will return to Hashem your God
that they will certainly do teshuvah.
And this is what is written:
"'The heart of her husband trusts in her'
as is written in the holy Zohar:
that they will certainly do teshuvah,
"And you will return to Hashem your God."
And this is why it says "Mi yimtza":
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּזֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קטו, ב)
Mi has the numerical value of fifty,
which is set aside for baalei teshuvah.
מַאן יִזְכֶּה לְמֶיהֱוֵי בָּהּ בִּשְׁלִימוּ כוּ׳
"who will merit to be in her in completeness," etc.,
'Who shall ascend the mountain of Hashem.'"
And it is written after it:
"One with clean hands and a pure heart";
זַכָּאָה מַאן דְּעָבִיד לוֹן דִּירָה בְּשַׁבָּת
fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling on Shabbos
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there"
for he merits the supernal Shabbos,
And it is written after it (Mishlei 31:11):
וּפֵירֵשׁ רַבִּי חַיִּים וִיטַאל זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
and Rabbi Chaim Vital, of blessed memory, explained it
as referring to the holy sparks,
as it says (Devarim 21:10), "and you shall take his captives captive."
For the purpose of the exile
is so that converts be added to them
and they explained this as the holy sparks.
with the corruption of the serpent,
when good and evil became intermingled,
among the nations of the world,
וְאַתָּה מְחַיֶּה אֶת כֻּלָּם (נְחֶמְיָה ט, ו)
and "You give life to them all" (Nechemiah 9:6);
and this is the purpose of the exiles,
that they rectify the entire root of the flaw.
And this is what it says:
"The heart of her husband trusts in her,"
that in every generation there will not be lacking
one who will capture the holy sparks
that are among the nations of the world;
אֵין דּוֹר שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ כְּאַבְרָהָם כוּ׳
"There is no generation without one like Avraham, etc.,
And this is what it says: "and he shall lack no spoil."
draws out the life force and the holy sparks,
and one can merit in it the completion of the rectification;
